paragraphs: The molding area is the center of the job. Workers mix sand to specification, form flask halves by machine or hand, place cores, close and secure the mold, and approve the cavity for pouring. After cooling, they break out and clean the casting and reclaim the sand. The cycle repeats several times per shift, with continuous shift coverage during peak orders.
